import os, sys; os.chdir(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)), "..", "..")); sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import pe_deal_graph.queries  # noqa: F401  (loads core, rules and graphs)
from pe_deal_graph.model.core import model, Company, EligibleTarget, Ownership, Fund

o = Ownership.ref()
f = Fund.ref()
print(model.where(
    EligibleTarget(Company), Company.score >= 70,
    o.company(Company), o.is_current(), o.fund(f),
).select(
    Company.name.alias("company"),
    Company.score.alias("score"),
    f.name.alias("fund"),
    o.stake_type.alias("stake"),
    o.start_date.alias("since"),
).to_df().to_string())

**Founder-led names on the Tier A list (score ≥ 70)**

| # | Company | Score | Fit | Readiness | Access | In CRM |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Bayside Pediatric Therapy Group | 85 | 30 | 45 | 10 | Yes |
| 2 | Quarry Records Retrieval | 75 | 25 | 40 | 10 | Yes |
| 3 | Tessmark Clinical Supply | 75 | 30 | 35 | 10 | Yes |

- **Bayside Pediatric Therapy Group:** Daniel Reyes is the founder CEO and has run it since 2008-01-01 (18.75 years) with no President or COO, which adds +10 for founder succession. Other points: CFO Elena Marsh came from a Northwind Fund II portfolio company (+15), Salthorpe Capital Advisors was engaged on 2026-05-15 (+10), debt matures 2027-06-30 (+10), and our deal team had a positive meeting on 2026-03-12 (+10).
- **Quarry Records Retrieval:** Esme Wakefield is the founder CEO and has run it since 2009-09-01 (17.08 years) with no President or COO (+10). Other points: CFO Leon Galloway came from a Glenhallow portfolio company (+15), debt matures 2027-03-31 (+10), new independent director Rafael Ortiz joined 2026-03-16 (+5), and a positive call on 2025-12-04 (+10).
- **Tessmark Clinical Supply:** Alicia Albrecht is the founder CEO and has run it since 1999-05-01 (27.42 years) with no President or COO (+10). Other points: Cedar Row Partners was engaged on 2026-06-02 (+10), debt matures 2028-02-28 (+10), new independent director Helen Voss joined 2026-02-17 (+5), and a positive meeting on 2026-06-10 (+10).

The other three Tier A names are sponsor-owned. Larkspur Revenue Partners is held by Kestrelmoor Capital Fund I, Saltmarsh Home Infusion by Coppervale Partners Fund II, and Fenwick Food Safety Labs by Sablewood Equity Fund II.

I picked these three from the Act 1 rows because each has a founder CEO and no sponsor holding. I could not confirm current ownership directly: the live check against the ownership records failed with an engine error.
